title: Unused Closing Cost Credit as Cover for a Per Diem Shortfall — Closing and Funding
content:
The credit cover of a Closing and Funding per diem shortfall is set from the borrower's Larkspur Closing Cost Credit records, because a charge priced right at closing would have drawn on a credit left unused. The remainder here is the per diem shortfall left after the record-error allowances.

**Rule.** Where the Larkspur closing cost credit whose application at closing paid the largest amount of prepaid items (on whatever date the credit rules book that application, and, where two such applications paid the same amount, the later-booked one) was also cut back for exceeding the eligible costs on the date that application was booked, the cut-back booked with the credit's application at closing, by at least the remainder after the record-error allowances, the cover is that whole remainder; where that credit was cut back on that date by less than that remainder, the cover is the amount cut back; otherwise there is no credit cover. The credit cover then comes off that remainder, never below zero; what is left is what the borrower pays.

**Records read.** In the Closing Cost Credit ledger, the applications at closing to the prepaid items cost category and their amounts identify the credit, and that credit's application gives the date it was booked. The amount cut back is the total of that same credit's reduction entries dated that booking date whose reason is that the credit exceeded the eligible costs.

| Credit identified (largest prepaid-items application at closing)? | Its cut-back for exceeding eligible costs, dated the application's booking date | Cover |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | at least the remainder | the whole remainder |
| Yes | above zero but less than the remainder | the amount cut back |
| Yes | none on that date | no cover |
| No credit applied to prepaid items | any | no cover |

## Examples (hypothetical remainder of 40.00)

Two credits were applied to prepaid items at closing, one for 130.00 booked on the 18th and one for 65.00; the 130.00 application identifies the credit, and its booking date is the 18th.

| That credit's cut-back | Cover | Left for the borrower |
|---|---|---|
| 55.00 dated the 18th | 40.00 | 0.00 |
| 12.50 dated the 18th | 12.50 | 27.50 |
| 12.50 dated the 11th | none (not booked with the application) | 40.00 |
| none (only the 65.00 credit was cut back) | none | 40.00 |

Had both applications been 110.00, the later-booked one would identify the credit.
